title: M.2 Source Damage, SHA Lineage, Workflow Coverage, and Path Integrity Protocol

confirmed_findings.rule: Do not strip BOM and leave an empty implementation; do not guess/reconstruct from filename.

confirmed_findings.details: Three UI entrypoint blobs were sampled as exact source matches; full asset, lockfile, generated-output, build, package and artifact lineage remains unverified.
Earlier runs for 41f44b... checked out merge commit 35e8de3... while the PR head subsequently advanced to ac785db...; every gate result must be bound to the same immutable target SHA.

recovery_rules: Capture original blob SHA, raw SHA-256, byte length, file mode, path, target commit and evidence before changing bytes.
Restore only from an explicitly identified authoritative repository/ref/commit/blob; filename similarity is not provenance.
For every repaired file, require destination Git blob SHA equality to the authoritative blob when byte-identical restoration is intended.
Treat a BOM as corruption only when the authoritative bytes differ or the language/file contract rejects it; preserve source-verified BOM blobs.
Treat a BOM-only file as missing implementation and block it; never turn it into an empty file.
Classify missing paths separately as source-transfer omission, intentional absence, or unknown after comparing authoritative tree, base tree, target tree, and workflow expectations.
Treat same-basename files as distinct until imports, package roots, build configs and ownership prove the intended path; never auto-merge or overwrite by basename.
A successful individual gate cannot override a failing source-integrity gate or missing evidence.

required_checks.name: Exact target binding
required_checks.requirement: PR head SHA, checked-out SHA, tested source SHA, audit target SHA and evidence target SHA must be identical; record merge SHA separately.

required_checks.name: UI/build/artifact lineage
required_checks.requirement: Bind UI sources, generated files, lockfiles, build toolchain, cache key, build output and artifact digest to the same target SHA.

required_checks.name: Workflow path coverage
required_checks.requirement: Enumerate changed paths, workflow path filters, job if conditions and downstream reusable/composite workflows; identify files without a validating gate.

required_checks.name: Required asset contract
required_checks.requirement: Compare each workflow-required file with authoritative source, PR base and PR head; restore real source assets or correct the workflow contract with evidence, never placeholders.

required_checks.name: Path and basename integrity
required_checks.requirement: Compare old/new tree paths, file modes, blob SHA, imports, package roots and UI/build targets; classify collisions as confirmed, disproven or unknown.

required_checks.name: Byte and parser integrity
required_checks.requirement: Scan tracked bytes for NUL, BOM, BOM-only, zero-byte/truncation and encoding issues; run language parser/compiler and focused tests.

required_checks.name: Authoritative recovery
required_checks.requirement: Keep files blocked if no trusted blob/branch exists; preserve a recovery ledger with original/recovered SHA and minimal diff.

required_checks.name: Independent exact-head rerun
required_checks.requirement: After repair, rerun all affected gates on one new immutable SHA and verify reports/artifacts identify that same SHA.

acceptance_criteria: All 14 BOM-affected Python files are restored from trusted source blobs or remain explicitly blocked; no guessed code.
The BOM-only create_change_queue.py has a verified authoritative implementation before it is unblocked.
The three unexpected-BOM files are compared byte-for-byte with authoritative sources and repaired only where justified.
The two deployment manifests match the known authoritative blob SHAs; the other required backup/restore scripts have explicit source-tree dispositions.
All 22 basename groups are traced or remain open with path-specific evidence.
UI/build/artifact SHA lineage and workflow changed-path coverage are machine-checked.
All required gates pass on the same exact target SHA without weakening checks; otherwise disposition remains NOT_CERTIFIED.
